route: Long-term visa travel/health insurance (MFA Consular Department)
authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Georgia (Consular Department)

evidence.excerpt: Alien shall hold travel/health insurance valid for the period of stay in Georgia, which, if necessary, will cover any expenses related to his/her health status and death. The travel/health insurance shall be valid all over Georgia.
The travel/health insurance shall be valid all over Georgia.
